name: km-electronic-filing-and-tax-procedure
description: Comoros reference to electronic filing, payment evidence and selected enforcement changes enacted in the 2026 finance law. Distinguishes the statutory framework from the implementing decisions required for rollout, explains platform receipt and settlement timing, and records outage and authentication provisions. Covers the new electronic information-request deadline and fiscal-flagrance response period without replacing the full appeals regime. An earlier electronic-filing mandate and the newer phased framework require reconciliation before operational advice. Current platform designation, commencement orders, penalties guidance and independent accountant review remain outstanding in this source-cited draft.
